coverage: Real Chromium Editor and media-library UI share a route-mocked isolated server.
An existing public image A is replaced by B in the Editor; Save persists draft B while the public page still renders published A.
Reload restores the saved draft B without publishing it.
The media library's archive preflight blocks A while the published Page Model still references it.
Explicit Publish is a separate request; after reload the public page renders B and A is no longer referenced.
A can then be archived, moves to the archived library, and is denied by public media delivery.
A second site receives 404 for the first site's private media, archive mutation and public media; its own media remains accessible.
The collected Page Model writes are exactly [Save=false, Publish=true].
